source_game.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("phase_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "phase_id", CAST("round" AS INTEGER) AS "round", CAST("day" AS VARCHAR) AS "day", to_char(kickoff AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') AS "kickoff", CAST("played" AS BOOLEAN) AS "played", CAST("home_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "home_id", CAST("away_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "away_id", CAST("home_score" AS INTEGER) AS "home_score", CAST("away_score" AS INTEGER) AS "away_score", CAST("home_aet" AS INTEGER) AS "home_aet", CAST("away_aet" AS INTEGER) AS "away_aet", CAST("home_pen" AS INTEGER) AS "home_pen", CAST("away_pen" AS INTEGER) AS "away_pen", CAST("stadium_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "stadium_id", CAST("referee_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "referee_id", CAST("attendance" AS INTEGER) AS "attendance", played OR NOT (coalesce(sync_status, 'scheduled') IN ('cancelled', 'abandoned', 'awarded')) AS "fixture_available"

source_phase.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("championship_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "championship_id", CAST("name" AS VARCHAR) AS "name"

source_championship.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("full_name" AS VARCHAR) AS "full_name", CAST("category_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "category_id"

source_team.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("name" AS VARCHAR) AS "name"

source_stadium.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("name" AS VARCHAR) AS "name"

source_referee.projection: CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("name" AS VARCHAR) AS "name"

game_card.partitionQuery: SELECT r.phase_id AS __partition,r.* FROM result_game_card r

team_game.partitionQuery: SELECT r.phase_key AS __partition,r.* FROM result_team_game r

source_game.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("phase_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "phase_id", CAST("round" AS INTEGER) AS "round", CAST("day" AS VARCHAR) AS "day", strftime(kickoff::TIMESTAMPTZ AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%fZ') AS "kickoff", CAST("played" AS BOOLEAN) AS "played", CAST("home_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "home_id", CAST("away_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "away_id", CAST("home_score" AS INTEGER) AS "home_score", CAST("away_score" AS INTEGER) AS "away_score", CAST("home_aet" AS INTEGER) AS "home_aet", CAST("away_aet" AS INTEGER) AS "away_aet", CAST("home_pen" AS INTEGER) AS "home_pen", CAST("away_pen" AS INTEGER) AS "away_pen", CAST("stadium_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "stadium_id", CAST("referee_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "referee_id", CAST("attendance" AS INTEGER) AS "attendance", played OR NOT (coalesce(sync_status, 'scheduled') IN ('cancelled', 'abandoned', 'awarded')) AS "fixture_available" FROM "game"

source_phase.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("championship_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "championship_id", CAST("name" AS VARCHAR) AS "name" FROM "phase"

source_championship.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("full_name" AS VARCHAR) AS "full_name", CAST("category_id" AS VARCHAR) AS "category_id" FROM "championship"

source_team.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("name" AS VARCHAR) AS "name" FROM "team"

source_stadium.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("name" AS VARCHAR) AS "name" FROM "stadium"

source_referee.query: SELECT CAST("id" AS VARCHAR) AS "id", CAST("name" AS VARCHAR) AS "name" FROM "referee"
